 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. STARKVILLE – Mississippi State football's final nonconference game will include a payment to its opponent.
 The Bulldogs (4-6) are hosting Tennessee Tech (9-2) at Davis Wade Stadium on Nov. 21 (noon, SEC Network+).
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement According to the game contract, MSU will pay the Golden Eagles $550,000 for playing the game.
 It's a common practice for nonconference games, especially for ones like this against FCS teams. This contract was signed in 2019 by previous MSU athletic director John Cohen.

Mandatory Credit: Nick Wosika-Imagn Images (Nick Wosika, IMAGN IMAGES via Reuters Connect) How much Mississippi State is paying Tennessee Tech, other nonconference games
 Tennessee Tech will be Mississippi State's third and final nonconference game of the season. Mississippi State beat Louisiana-Monroe, 62-13, on Sept. 5 and Minnesota, 38-13, on Sept. 12.
 The Bulldogs paid Louisiana-Monroe $1.45 million for the game.

 The Minnesota game is part of a home-and-home series with the Bulldogs hosting the Golden Gophers next season. MSU got $350,000 for this season's game and will give that money back to Minnesota next season.
 Mississippi State football future schedules for nonconference games
 2027: vs. Missouri State (Aug. 28), vs. Minnesota (Sept. 11), vs. Chattanooga (Oct. 9)
 2028: vs. North Alabama (Sept. 2), vs. Louisiana Tech (Sept. 16)
 2029: vs. West Georgia (Aug. 25), vs. Southern Miss (Sept. 15)
 2030: at Oklahoma State (Sept. 7), vs. Troy (Sept. 14)
 2031: vs. Arkansas State (Aug. 30), vs. Oklahoma State (Sept. 6)
 2032: vs. Tulane (Sept. 11)
 2033: vs. Chattanooga (Aug. 27)
 2034: vs. Memphis (Sept. 16)
